assistant.description: The credit union's member-support agent (in review).

chat.title: Chat with Dana Whitlock: overdraft coverage
turns: Hi, this is Dana Whitlock. Two small card purchases overdrew my account last month and I paid two overdraft fees. Please turn off overdraft coverage on my debit card. I would rather the card just be declined.
I can help with that. I have sent your request to opt out of overdraft coverage for debit card and ATM transactions to Member Services. They process opt-outs within one business day.
Thanks. Keep my Premier Checking as it is, I always keep well over the minimum balance.
Noted. Your Premier Checking account stays as it is.

staff_note: Member Services note (Jordan Pike): Dana Whitlock's opt-out of overdraft coverage for one-time debit card and ATM transactions has been processed. Confirmation LV-88213.

questions.question: What is the overdraft fee, and how many can I be charged in one day?
questions.search: What is the overdraft fee per item and how many overdraft fees per day?

claims.text: The overdraft fee is 29 dollars per item.
You can be charged at most 3 overdraft fees per business day.
No fee is charged if you are overdrawn by 50 dollars or less.

questions.question: I deposited a 7,000 dollar check today. When can I use the money?
questions.search: How long is the hold on a check deposit over 5,525 dollars?

claims.text: Deposits over 5,525 dollars in one day can be held: the first 225 dollars is available the next business day.
The rest is available on the 7th business day.

questions.question: How much does an international wire cost, and when do I have to send the request?
questions.search: How much does an outgoing international wire cost and what is the cutoff time for international wires?

claims.text: An outgoing international wire costs 45 dollars.

replace_with.text: An outgoing international wire costs 40 dollars.

claims.text: International wires must be requested by 1:00 pm Eastern time.
You can recall an international wire at any time until the receiving bank credits it.
claims.needle: recall an international wire at any time

questions.question: Will my debit card purchases still go into overdraft?
questions.search: Does overdraft coverage apply to one-time debit card transactions?

claims.text: Your opt-out of overdraft coverage for debit card and ATM transactions has been processed (confirmation LV-88213).
Overdraft coverage for one-time debit card and ATM transactions applies only to members who opt in.
claims.needle: applies only to members who opt in
